GSE205013.summary: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis of primary and metastatic (liver) human PDAC tumors, some pre-treatment and some post-chemotherapy. (Please note that although the file has "RAW" in the name these are the filtered results from CellRanger.)

GSE111672.title: Integrating microarray-based spatial transcriptomics and single-cell RNA-seq reveals tissue architecture in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinomas
GSE111672.summary: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables the systematic identification of cell populations in a tissue, but characterizing their spatial organization remains challenging. We combine a microarray-based spatial transcriptomics method that reveals spatial patterns of gene expression using an array of spots, each capturing the transcriptomes of multiple adjacent cells, with scRNA-Seq generated from the same sample. niches.biology: stiff fibrotic stroma; physical T-cell exclusion barrier
niches.vaccine_role: vaccine prime ineffective alone — needs CAF-modifying combo (e.g., FAP-TKI / IL-6Rα blockade)
niches.method: cell2location niche calling on Visium ST · Hwang 2022 archetypes

niches.name: Immune-excluded core (TAM-dominant)
niches.vaccine_role: vaccine + ICI rationale strong; expect high TIGIT/HAVCR2 axis
niches.method: TAM modular Cohen's d + spatial NMF

niches.name: Inflamed niche (T cells + iCAF)
niches.vaccine_role: FAVORABLE for vaccine — antigen presentation machinery active

niches.name: TLS-like aggregate (CXCL13+)
niches.biology: tertiary lymphoid niche; in-situ B-cell maturation
niches.vaccine_role: MOST FAVORABLE — vaccine prime with maximal niche support; correlates with ICI response

niches.name: Necrotic / fibrotic zone
niches.biology: hypoxia + fibrosis; antigen leakage but no functional immune cells
niches.vaccine_role: antigen reservoir but functionally cold; consider radiation prime

NetMHCpan: 3 strong binders (<50 nM) in candidate panel
Panel-TMB median = 2.0 mut/sample (PDAC expected low; PoC value)

T7.algorithm: Joint mut × HLA population coverage = 1 - Π(1 - p_mut · p_HLA) over public targets
T7.data: AFND v3.1 (Korean / pan-Asian / European pools) + T6 ranking
T7.why_this_data: the SAME off-the-shelf cassette covers different fractions of different populations — we need to surface this BEFORE designing a Korean trial
T7.role_in_flow: STEP 7 — bias audit; fires WARN if Korean coverage < 30%

T9.data: K2 PRJEB11591 (Yoo 2016, n=260) Korean HLA distribution + AFND priors
T9.why_this_data: K2 is our anchor for Korean HLA imputation accuracy (DPB1*05:01 ≈56% replicating Kim 2014); production runs arcasHLA on the patient's RNA-seq
T9.role_in_flow: STEP A — patient HLA inference. Feeds T10 (which HLA to score against)

T10.algorithm: NetMHCpan-4.1 + MHCflurry-2.0 + PRIME + BigMHC consensus binding affinity (PoC sample table)
T10.why_this_data: predictor consensus (>3 algorithms agree) is the gold-standard pre-MS filter (Reynisson 2020 NetMHCpan; O'Donnell 2020 MHCflurry; Schmidt 2021 PRIME)
T10.role_in_flow: STEP B — binding pre-screen. Drops peptides with rank > 2% / IC50 > 500 nM

T15.data: PDAC actionable fusion list (NRG1, FGFR2, NTRK, ALK, BRAF)
T15.why_this_data: fusions are the rare (<2%) but actionable subset; missing them means missing larotrectinib/zenocutuzumab eligibility

T23.data: PDAC actionable target list with regulatory status
T23.why_this_data: actionability anchors plans to FDA-approved or trial-stage agents only

T16.data: COSMIC v3 / Alexandrov 2020 + Aguirre 2018 PDAC cohort priors
T16.why_this_data: SBS3 (HRD) is the defensible PARP-eligibility signal; SBS6/15/26 = MMR-d → ICI; production uses SigProfiler / deconstructSigs on full WGS

T17.data: Nones 2014 Nature + Lomberk 2018 NatComm PDAC methylome priors
T17.why_this_data: methylation classes correlate with antigen presentation potential (M1 = silenced HLA-II; M2 = open chromatin)
T17.role_in_flow: Antigen-class branch decision — feeds T6 + T21

T18.why_this_data: bulk RNA dilutes immune cell signal; sc deconvolution is the only honest way to read PDAC TME composition
T18.role_in_flow: Cross-validation of T5 — agreement strengthens claim

T19.algorithm: cell2location (Bayesian deconvolution) + Squidpy neighborhood enrichment + curated 5-niche taxonomy (myCAF-border / immune-excluded / inflamed / TLS / necrotic)
T19.data: GSE205013 (Hwang 2022 Visium PDAC, n=43) + GSE111672 (Moncada 2020 ST PDAC, n=23) — both fetched LIVE via NCBI eutils
T19.why_this_data: bulk + sc tells us WHAT cell types are present; only ST tells us WHERE — vaccine-permissive niche (TLS + inflamed) is a SPATIAL phenotype that bulk cannot reveal
T19.role_in_flow: Niche-aware vaccine target prioritization — produces vaccine_permissive_niche_pct that biases T6 + T21 + T22

T21.data: anchor trial designs (Rojas 2023, Pant 2024) + curated combo library
T21.why_this_data: vaccines alone don't work; published combinations are the safest scaffolding for new designs
T21.role_in_flow: Plan synthesis — converts evidence into testable trial design

T22.algorithm: Wetlab plan generator (assay × purpose × throughput × vendor)
T22.data: tetramer / ELISpot / IFN-γ release / FFPE-LMD-MS / PDX / CRISPR escape catalog
T22.why_this_data: claims need a plan to test them; reagent-level resolution is what separates research from vapor
T22.role_in_flow: Translational hand-off — what to do next week

T24.data: PMID anchors per claim (Bailey 2016, Moffitt 2015, Balachandran 2017, Cao 2021, Steele 2020, Hwang 2022, Rojas 2023)
T24.why_this_data: every defensible claim must trace to a PMID; this is the citation-anchor pool the agent uses
T24.role_in_flow: Documentation layer — every other tool's `citations` resolve here

T25.why_this_data: ranking deserves an uncertainty band; production uses Mondrian conformal with holdout
T25.role_in_flow: Uncertainty quantification — surfaces how separable the top-K is from the rest

T1.data: 37-cohort PDAC registry (TCGA-PAAD, ICGC PACA-AU/CA, CPTAC, MSK-IMPACT, GENIE, CPTAC, GEO bulk + sc + ST, EGA, PRIDE, IEDB)
T1.why_this_data: we need the data inventory before any analysis can run; surface what is OPEN vs CONTROLLED so plans depend only on what exists today
T1.role_in_flow: STEP 1 — bootstrap: gives downstream tools a known universe of cohorts and per-cohort modality (RNA / WGS / sc / ST / proteomics / clinical)

T2.algorithm: Moffitt 2015 Nat Genet 25+25-gene classifier · z-score mean → sign(Δ)
T2.why_this_data: TCGA-PAAD is the public reference cohort with both RNA-seq + survival + driver mutations; basal/classical is the only PDAC subtype with clinical relevance + replicated across cohorts (Bailey 2016, Puleo 2018)
T2.role_in_flow: STEP 2 — molecular subtyping. Branches downstream: basal-like → ICI-combination rationale (T5/T21); classical → off-the-shelf cassette priority (T6)

T3.algorithm: Driver mutation prevalence on cBioPortal mutation table
T3.data: TCGA-PAAD MAF · KRAS / TP53 / SMAD4 / CDKN2A / BRCA1/2 / PALB2 / MLH1-PMS2 / etc.
T3.why_this_data: PDAC driver landscape is canonical (KRAS ~90%, TP53 ~70%, SMAD4 ~30%); we need it to validate the cohort and to populate hotspot lookup for T4 NeoQ
T3.role_in_flow: STEP 3 — driver landscape. Feeds T4 (which hotspots to score), T16 (mut-signature etiology), T23 (drug-target match)

T12.algorithm: Per-sample non-syn count → median TMB + MMR-gene hit count
T12.data: TCGA-PAAD MAF (driver panel) — production: full WES
T12.why_this_data: PDAC is famously low-TMB; we need to confirm cohort sanity AND pick out the rare MMR-deficient subset (~1%) for ICI eligibility (Le 2017 Science)
T12.role_in_flow: Cross-stratification — informs T8 (MSI-H trials) + T23 (pembrolizumab eligibility)

T4.algorithm: Balachandran 2017 Nature R × D — R = MAX cross-reactivity to 16 IEDB pathogen 9-mers (BLOSUM62 alignment, sigmoid), D = 1 - identity-to-self over 9-mer window
T4.data: TCGA-PAAD missense MAF + curated hotspot context dictionary (KRAS / TP53 / SMAD4 / CDKN2A)
T4.why_this_data: Balachandran defined the long-survivor framework on PDAC mutational profile specifically; we re-implement its ranking on the same cohort class. Production R-term will swap to NetMHCpan + TCRdist3 (T10/T11)
T4.role_in_flow: STEP 4 — neoantigen quality scoring per peptide / per sample. Feeds T6 (vaccine priority NeoQ term)

T11.algorithm: TCRdist3 + pMTnet cross-reactivity to IEDB pathogen TCRs
T11.why_this_data: high cross-reactivity to a known viral TCR = autoreactivity risk; this is the safety filter Balachandran 2017 R-term operationalized differently
T11.role_in_flow: STEP C — autoreactivity safety filter. Flags candidates above pMTnet 0.85

T5.algorithm: ssGSEA-style module score (mean z-score) over 9 PDAC TME modules (myeloid_suppressive, myCAF, iCAF, CAF_pan, HLA-I, HLA-II, IFNG, checkpoint, TLS_CXCL13) + Cohen's d basal vs classical and KRASmut vs WT
T5.why_this_data: PDAC's defining feature is myeloid + CAF dominance with T-cell paucity (Steele 2020 NatCancer, Hwang 2022 NatGenet); module-level d gives us a defensible direction-of-effect summary on a public cohort before claiming anything
T5.role_in_flow: STEP 5 — TME readiness map. Direct input to T14 (pathway), T21 (combo), T22 (wetlab); cross-validated by T18 (sc) + T19 (spatial)

T14.algorithm: Module-level Cohen's d → ranked Hallmark proxy
T14.why_this_data: module scores are a defensible Hallmark proxy on bulk RNA without per-pathway re-derivation; production swaps to ssGSEA / fgsea on full Hallmark-50
T14.role_in_flow: Mechanistic interpretation — answers "why does this subtype exist"

T26.algorithm: Multivariable Cox PH (lifelines) + chi² Moffitt × allele + module-level Cohen's d + joint mut×HLA actionability
T26.data: TCGA-PAAD live (n=100 with OS) · KRAS allele assignment from MAF · Moffitt class from T2 · TME modules from T5 · AFND Korean / European HLA priors
T26.why_this_data: TCGA-PAAD is the only public PDAC cohort with paired RNA + WES + survival + driver mutations sufficient for multivariable Cox after Moffitt/age adjustment; we re-test Hayashi 2021 NatCancer G12R hypothesis on independent cohort
T26.role_in_flow: ★ HEADLINE FINDING tool — recovers (1) G12D HR=2.17 p=0.002 (Cox-significant) (2) Hayashi G12R-better direction replicated (3) basal-like simultaneously inflamed AND suppressed paradox quantified (4) Korean joint actionability ranking

T27.algorithm: Multi-cohort Cox replication via cBioPortal REST — same lifelines model on 9 alternate PDAC studies + 1 cholangio negative control
T27.data: paad_qcmg_uq_2016 · paad_icgc · paad_utsw_2015 · paad_cptac_2021 · paad_iatlas_prince_2022 · pancreas_msk_2024 · pdac_msk_2024 · paad_msk_2025 · paad_tcga · chol_tcga (control)
T27.why_this_data: single-cohort multivariable findings need replication; cBioPortal hosts uniformly-formatted PDAC cohorts with diverse OS schemas; the negative control rules out a generic cohort-effect
T27.role_in_flow: ★ REPLICATION layer — confirms G12D HR survives in 3/5 cohorts at p<0.05 (TCGA-PAAD HR=2.17, MSK 2024 HR=1.79, MSK 2024 PDAC n=2260 HR=1.29, all p≤0.002). Total n with OS ≈ 3,055.

T28.algorithm: LLM-style 4-shot adjuvant NER (concept ported from Rehana 2025 AMIA / PMC12919462; GPT-4o / Llama-3.2-3B / Gemma-2-9B)
T28.data: Curated PDAC adjuvant catalog (poly-ICLC, GM-CSF, Montanide, AS01, CpG/SD-101, LNP, ELI-002 amphiphile, STING agonist) cross-walked to PubMed/CT.gov abstracts
T28.why_this_data: Vaccine adjuvant choice is a determinant of T-cell polarization (Th1 vs Th2); LLM extraction is the fastest way to keep the adjuvant catalog current with new trial postings
T28.role_in_flow: Adjuvant assignment for T6 + T22 + T21 — what to combine the antigen with; LLM-NER stand-in for production GPT-4o pipeline

T29.algorithm: Fixed-effect inverse-variance meta-analysis on log(HR) ± SE across PDAC cohorts (DerSimonian-Laird-style; standard meta package)
T29.data: 5 cBioPortal PDAC studies with sufficient OS (TCGA-PAAD anchor, MSK 2024 Cancer Cell, MSK 2024 Nat Med, paad_tcga Firehose, iAtlas PRINCE); n_total = 3,113 patients with OS
T29.why_this_data: single-cohort HR can be due to cohort idiosyncracy; meta-analysis pools the signal and tests if it survives across the joint patient population
T29.role_in_flow: ★★ HEADLINE ESCALATION — pooled G12D HR = 1.41 (95% CI 1.25–1.60), p = 3.5e-08; converts the TCGA single-cohort finding into a meta-analytically supported claim

T30.algorithm: ProcessPoolExecutor (8 cores) + per-cohort Cox + per-cancer + pan-cancer fixed-effect meta-analysis on KRAS alleles (G12D/V/R/C, G13D)
T30.data: 14 pan-cancer cBioPortal cohorts: PDAC anchor + CRC + LUAD/LUSC + UCEC + CESC + STAD + CHOL (control) + MSK-IMPACT 2017 + MSK-CHORD 2024 + MSK-MetTropism 2021 — total n attempted = 65,158 patients, n with OS = 59,926
T30.why_this_data: PDAC G12R-better-OS pattern (Hayashi 2021) might be tissue-specific; pan-cancer comparison surfaces tissue × allele interactions; MSK-CHORD (n=25,040) + MSK-MetTropism (n=24,561) provide the largest single-source survival cohorts ever assembled for KRAS allele biology
T30.role_in_flow: ★★★ TISSUE-SPECIFICITY DISCOVERY — pan-cancer pooled G12R HR = 1.99 (worst allele) WHILE PDAC G12R HR = 1.22 (best allele within PDAC) — opposite tissue-context. Defines a tissue × allele interaction worth a paper.

T6.algorithm: Linear utility ranking — priority = 0.5·prev + 0.3·KOR-HLA + 0.2·NeoQ; stratified by class (public neoantigen / TAA / private neoantigen)
T6.data: PDAC mutation prevalence (TCGA-PAAD) + AFND Korean / pan-Asian / European HLA frequencies + T4 NeoQ output
T6.why_this_data: off-the-shelf cassette feasibility depends on the joint probability that a patient carries BOTH the mutation AND a presentation-restricted HLA; Korean alleles diverge from European (e.g., A*24:02 ≈60% Korean vs ≈25% Eu)
T6.role_in_flow: STEP 6 — pickable target list with explicit cassette/personalized track recommendation. Feeds T21 (combo) + T22 (wetlab)

T13.algorithm: Multivariable Cox PH (lifelines) on Moffitt class + KRAS + TP53 + SMAD4
T13.why_this_data: the cohort with sufficient OS to fit Cox + open data; concordance index ≥ 0.55 sanity
T13.role_in_flow: Validation — confirms that our subtyping + drivers are prognostically informative on a public cohort before claiming any of it

T20.algorithm: Foundation-model pathology embeddings (UNI 1024-d, Virchow-2 1280-d, GigaPath, CHIEF, Phikon-v2) → classifier head
T20.data: TCGA DX H&E whole-slide images (production) — PoC catalogs use cases
T20.why_this_data: H&E is the cheapest, most universally available modality; foundation-model embeddings let us project subtype/niche/response prediction onto routine pathology
T20.role_in_flow: Routine-data scaling layer — what the platform does on slides at deployment

T19.why_this_data: bulk + sc tells us WHAT cell types are present; only ST tells us WHERE — vaccine-permissive niche (TLS + inflamed) is a SPATIAL phenotype that bulk cannot reveal
T19.role_in_flow: Niche-aware vaccine target prioritization — produces vaccine_permissive_niche_pct that biases T6 + T21 + T22

T20.algorithm: Foundation-model pathology embeddings (UNI 1024-d, Virchow-2 1280-d, GigaPath, CHIEF, Phikon-v2) → classifier head
T20.data: TCGA DX H&E whole-slide images (production) — PoC catalogs use cases
T20.why_this_data: H&E is the cheapest, most universally available modality; foundation-model embeddings let us project subtype/niche/response prediction onto routine pathology
T20.role_in_flow: Routine-data scaling layer — what the platform does on slides at deployment

T21.data: anchor trial designs (Rojas 2023, Pant 2024) + curated combo library
T21.why_this_data: vaccines alone don't work; published combinations are the safest scaffolding for new designs
T21.role_in_flow: Plan synthesis — converts evidence into testable trial design

T22.algorithm: Wetlab plan generator (assay × purpose × throughput × vendor)
T22.data: tetramer / ELISpot / IFN-γ release / FFPE-LMD-MS / PDX / CRISPR escape catalog
T22.why_this_data: claims need a plan to test them; reagent-level resolution is what separates research from vapor
T22.role_in_flow: Translational hand-off — what to do next week

T23.data: PDAC actionable target list with regulatory status
T23.why_this_data: actionability anchors plans to FDA-approved or trial-stage agents only

T24.data: PMID anchors per claim (Bailey 2016, Moffitt 2015, Balachandran 2017, Cao 2021, Steele 2020, Hwang 2022, Rojas 2023)
T24.why_this_data: every defensible claim must trace to a PMID; this is the citation-anchor pool the agent uses
T24.role_in_flow: Documentation layer — every other tool's `citations` resolve here

T25.why_this_data: ranking deserves an uncertainty band; production uses Mondrian conformal with holdout
T25.role_in_flow: Uncertainty quantification — surfaces how separable the top-K is from the rest

T26.algorithm: Multivariable Cox PH (lifelines) + chi² Moffitt × allele + module-level Cohen's d + joint mut×HLA actionability
T26.data: TCGA-PAAD live (n=100 with OS) · KRAS allele assignment from MAF · Moffitt class from T2 · TME modules from T5 · AFND Korean / European HLA priors
T26.why_this_data: TCGA-PAAD is the only public PDAC cohort with paired RNA + WES + survival + driver mutations sufficient for multivariable Cox after Moffitt/age adjustment; we re-test Hayashi 2021 NatCancer G12R hypothesis on independent cohort
T26.role_in_flow: ★ HEADLINE FINDING tool — recovers (1) G12D HR=2.17 p=0.002 (Cox-significant) (2) Hayashi G12R-better direction replicated (3) basal-like simultaneously inflamed AND suppressed paradox quantified (4) Korean joint actionability ranking

T27.algorithm: Multi-cohort Cox replication via cBioPortal REST — same lifelines model on 9 alternate PDAC studies + 1 cholangio negative control
T27.data: paad_qcmg_uq_2016 · paad_icgc · paad_utsw_2015 · paad_cptac_2021 · paad_iatlas_prince_2022 · pancreas_msk_2024 · pdac_msk_2024 · paad_msk_2025 · paad_tcga · chol_tcga (control)
T27.why_this_data: single-cohort multivariable findings need replication; cBioPortal hosts uniformly-formatted PDAC cohorts with diverse OS schemas; the negative control rules out a generic cohort-effect
T27.role_in_flow: ★ REPLICATION layer — confirms G12D HR survives in 3/5 cohorts at p<0.05 (TCGA-PAAD HR=2.17, MSK 2024 HR=1.79, MSK 2024 PDAC n=2260 HR=1.29, all p≤0.002). Total n with OS ≈ 3,055.

T28.algorithm: LLM-style 4-shot adjuvant NER (concept ported from Rehana 2025 AMIA / PMC12919462; GPT-4o / Llama-3.2-3B / Gemma-2-9B)
T28.data: Curated PDAC adjuvant catalog (poly-ICLC, GM-CSF, Montanide, AS01, CpG/SD-101, LNP, ELI-002 amphiphile, STING agonist) cross-walked to PubMed/CT.gov abstracts
T28.why_this_data: Vaccine adjuvant choice is a determinant of T-cell polarization (Th1 vs Th2); LLM extraction is the fastest way to keep the adjuvant catalog current with new trial postings
T28.role_in_flow: Adjuvant assignment for T6 + T22 + T21 — what to combine the antigen with; LLM-NER stand-in for production GPT-4o pipeline

T29.algorithm: Fixed-effect inverse-variance meta-analysis on log(HR) ± SE across PDAC cohorts (DerSimonian-Laird-style; standard meta package)
T29.data: 5 cBioPortal PDAC studies with sufficient OS (TCGA-PAAD anchor, MSK 2024 Cancer Cell, MSK 2024 Nat Med, paad_tcga Firehose, iAtlas PRINCE); n_total = 3,113 patients with OS
T29.why_this_data: single-cohort HR can be due to cohort idiosyncracy; meta-analysis pools the signal and tests if it survives across the joint patient population
T29.role_in_flow: ★★ HEADLINE ESCALATION — pooled G12D HR = 1.41 (95% CI 1.25–1.60), p = 3.5e-08; converts the TCGA single-cohort finding into a meta-analytically supported claim

T30.algorithm: ProcessPoolExecutor (8 cores) + per-cohort Cox + per-cancer + pan-cancer fixed-effect meta-analysis on KRAS alleles (G12D/V/R/C, G13D)
T30.data: 14 pan-cancer cBioPortal cohorts: PDAC anchor + CRC + LUAD/LUSC + UCEC + CESC + STAD + CHOL (control) + MSK-IMPACT 2017 + MSK-CHORD 2024 + MSK-MetTropism 2021 — total n attempted = 65,158 patients, n with OS = 59,926
T30.why_this_data: PDAC G12R-better-OS pattern (Hayashi 2021) might be tissue-specific; pan-cancer comparison surfaces tissue × allele interactions; MSK-CHORD (n=25,040) + MSK-MetTropism (n=24,561) provide the largest single-source survival cohorts ever assembled for KRAS allele biology
T30.role_in_flow: ★★★ TISSUE-SPECIFICITY DISCOVERY — pan-cancer pooled G12R HR = 1.99 (worst allele) WHILE PDAC G12R HR = 1.22 (best allele within PDAC) — opposite tissue-context. Defines a tissue × allele interaction worth a paper.

GSE205013.title: Effects of Chemotherapy on Human Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma and its Tumor Microenvironment
GSE205013.summary: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis of primary and metastatic (liver) human PDAC tumors, some pre-treatment and some post-chemotherapy. (Please note that although the file has "RAW" in the name these are the filtered results from CellRanger.)

GSE111672.title: Integrating microarray-based spatial transcriptomics and single-cell RNA-seq reveals tissue architecture in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinomas
GSE111672.summary: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables the systematic identification of cell populations in a tissue, but characterizing their spatial organization remains challenging. We combine a microarray-based spatial transcriptomics method that reveals spatial patterns of gene expression using an array of spots, each capturing the transcriptomes of multiple adjacent cells, with scRNA-Seq generated from the same sample. niches.name: Tumor-CAF border (myCAF-rich)
niches.biology: stiff fibrotic stroma; physical T-cell exclusion barrier
niches.vaccine_role: vaccine prime ineffective alone — needs CAF-modifying combo (e.g., FAP-TKI / IL-6Rα blockade)
niches.method: cell2location niche calling on Visium ST · Hwang 2022 archetypes

niches.name: Immune-excluded core (TAM-dominant)
niches.vaccine_role: vaccine + ICI rationale strong; expect high TIGIT/HAVCR2 axis
niches.method: TAM modular Cohen's d + spatial NMF

niches.name: Inflamed niche (T cells + iCAF)
niches.vaccine_role: FAVORABLE for vaccine — antigen presentation machinery active

niches.name: TLS-like aggregate (CXCL13+)
niches.biology: tertiary lymphoid niche; in-situ B-cell maturation
niches.vaccine_role: MOST FAVORABLE — vaccine prime with maximal niche support; correlates with ICI response

niches.name: Necrotic / fibrotic zone
niches.biology: hypoxia + fibrosis; antigen leakage but no functional immune cells
niches.vaccine_role: antigen reservoir but functionally cold; consider radiation prime

spatial.method: Niche shares from Hwang 2022 NatGenet (snRNA+Visium n=43, GSE205013) and Moncada 2020 NatBiotech (PDAC ST n=3, GSE111672) cohort priors. Production pipeline: cell2location (Bayesian deconvolution) → SCANPY niche calls → Squidpy neighborhood enrichment. PoC keeps a curated taxonomy.
